taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: Plumbing run for the X1 allmimic path: 60 iterations / 1024 envs, same entry script, image and branch as the 3000-iteration task. Purpose: prove clone -> pip install -> CUDA/mjlab import -> train -> log.jsonl -> TensorBoard mirror -> checkpoint publication -> gm task data get, in a few minutes, before spending a full run. Image: plain Ubuntu 24.04 (the IsaacSim 5.1 image pins numpy<2 via an Isaac Sim constraint, which conflicts with requirements.txt numpy 2.4.6).
